_comment: Playlist sources with direct M3U/W3U feeds are listed under sources. Optional url_env entries are skipped and explicitly reported until configured. reference_checks probe sites/repos that do not publish a static playlist; they are not imported as channels.

sources.name: priority-channels
sources.note: Curated links for the channels that matter most (Nickelodeon, NickToons, MeTV, MeTV Toons). Written by scripts/channel_hunt.py, which only keeps links it verified end to end; re-checked on every scrape like any other source.

sources.name: ae-networks
sources.note: Curated A&E and A+E Networks linear and FAST M3U8 feeds (checked on every scrape).

sources.name: iptv-org
sources.note: Public worldwide channel index from iptv-org/iptv.

priority_channels._comment: Used by scripts/channel_hunt.py. Each target is hunted for by name and tvg-id across the local corpus, the configured upstream indexes and (with --github-search) public M3U files on GitHub. Every candidate is verified end to end - HLS variant plus a real media segment - before it is written to the curated playlist. A target whose aliases are also matched by another target is not collected by the shorter one, so MeTV never picks up MeTV Toons links.
priority_channels._blocklist_comment: URL fragments that must never be collected: feeds that are publicly listed under a channel they do not actually carry.

reference_checks.name: eja.tv
reference_checks.note: The site is checked for reachability only. No static M3U export was verified; it is not scraped/imported as channels. Configure EJA_M3U_URL only if you have an authorized direct playlist URL.

reference_checks.name: StepDaddyLiveHD
reference_checks.note: Repository tree is checked for static M3U files. The project describes a self-hosted proxy whose playlist is generated at an instance URL; configure STEPDADDYLIVEHD_PLAYLIST_URL to check a hosted instance.

reference_checks.name: dlive.sx
reference_checks.note: DaddyLiveHD 24/7 channel index. The page lists channels as HTML player pages (/stream/stream-<id>.php) whose stream address is resolved by JavaScript at run time, and its channels/schedule API needs a key issued by the operator, so the site publishes no static playlist. The catalogue is counted for visibility only and no channel is imported. Set DLIVE_M3U_URL to an authorized direct playlist URL - for example one generated by a self-hosted proxy - to import it and have every link checked like any other source.

discovery._comment: Used by scripts/discover.py on the monthly schedule. Candidates are fetched, measured against the published playlist, and sample-checked. Anything that clears the thresholds is written to playlists/discovery/approved-sources.json and merged into the next regular scrape. Nothing is published without the daily link check.

candidates.name: Fanmingming-Live
candidates.note: Large daily-updated public live-TV list. The best TV M3U in the repository tree is selected each month.

candidates.name: Akiraleal-IPTV
candidates.note: Public IPTV playlist repository; the largest static M3U in the tree is selected automatically.

candidates.name: TianmuTNT-IPTV
candidates.note: Public IPTV playlist repository, refreshed frequently.
